mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.memNm AS memNm, m.profileImageName AS profileImageName FROM reply r left join member m ON r.memNo = m.memNo WHERE r.boardId = #{boardId} AND r.boardNo = #{boardNo} AND r.deleteYn = FALSE ORDER BY r.groupNo, r.groupOrder
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reply(boardId, boardNo, memNo, contents, groupNo, groupOrder, depth, parentNo, answerCnt, regDt) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{boardNo}, #{memNo}, #{contents}, #{groupNo}, #{groupOrder}, #{depth}, #{parentNo}, #{answerCnt}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE reply SET deleteYn = TRUE WHERE replyNo = #{replyNo}
UPDATE reply SET contents = #{contents} WHERE boardId = #{boardId} AND replyNo = #{replyNo}
UPDATE reply SET answerCnt = answerCnt + 1 WHERE replyNo = #{parentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reply WHERE boardId = #{boardId} AND boardNo = #{boardNo} AND groupNo = #{groupNo} AND groupOrder >= #{groupOrder} + 1
